scenes.text: Shortlist helps you compare supplier quotes and choose one that meets your budget and deadline. These three quotes are fictional.
Click a price to see the exact words it came from.
Cedar confirms a delay. I correct the date and lock it, so Harbor becomes the suitable choice.
Now Cedar sends a new quote. A real agent reads it and saves the new price and shipping. My locked date stays. The updated facts appear in the comparison, and Shortlist verifies the saved change.
Reloading keeps the correction. Lowering the budget to five hundred ninety dollars leaves no suitable offer.
Undo restores the earlier budget. Export downloads the decision and its original quote evidence. This recording shows the actual working application.
